caption: The drawing is a pattern sample featuring a repeating design composed of bouquets of flowers against a beige background. The bouquets contain pink and purple flowers with green leaves, arranged in clusters. Some bouquets are interconnected by vertical strings of green foliage. The background features an overlaid decorative pattern made up of interlocking, curved, beige lines that form oval and looped shapes behind the flower arrangements, using a slightly darker beige tone to provide a subtle contrast with the main background. The overall composition is symmetrical and evenly spaced, with each bouquet matching in size, color, and shape across the drawing. The pattern is centrally placed on a larger off-white or light beige sheet, with the artist's name, "Hager," lightly inscribed in pencil in the lower-left corner.
title: Wallpaper
